positive_styles: gentle Brazilian forro pe-de-serra in a soft xote groove
sanfona accordion is the lead instrument and carries the hook
triangle keeps a light steady pulse
a soft hand drum answers the barks
chorus melody uses four notes of the major scale with one small happy upward leap on the hook word, then gently falling back
the lead instrument answers each sung line with a short echo
vocal upfront and clear, clear diction, clean modern children's music production, studio quality
very short instrumental intro, the vocal starts within two seconds
the same warm young adult female lead singer throughout the whole song, identical voice, timbre and vocal register in every section, sweet and clear, natural Brazilian Portuguese
